key_findings: The approved design authority consistently uses a light editorial system with mono kickers, system sans typography, muted navigation, quiet bands, and restrained card/panel surfaces.
Phase 2 successfully converted those patterns into reusable app-wide tokens and components without materializing final page content.
Validation commands could not be executed because the shell lacks npm/node, but this did not block design-system delivery.
html_css_design_source_findings: All approved page designs expose embedded CSS rather than separate CSS files.
Repeated values include oklch-based background, ink, border, and accent colors; a 1200px container cap; gutter clamp(18px, 4vw, 32px); and body sizes around 17px-19px.
design_system_decisions: Adopted authority color and typography intent into global CSS variables rather than route-specific styles.
Introduced PageShell, PageIntro, EvidenceBlock, SignalCard, and CTABlock as reusable primitives for Phase 3.
Kept placeholders active and upgraded only their shared framing, avoiding final narrative or content materialization.
